about: Recording batch E3f of ADR 0012: an oracle session whose worker serves the nativets tag, with native fixtures (values, a throw, a fetch of the loopback sink, and codebase scripts under //native, WR-50), and the recordings that semantics revisions SC3 and SC4 requested in docs/design/README.md (Recording requests for batch E3f), each in the oracle configuration it needs (oracle.session). Expects are the reference's predictions; where the oracle disagreed the expect holds the recording with a note, and the contradiction is listed below. No milestone needs E3f merged, so the batch has no gates; the runs windmill-lite already matches join the flow suite.

deferred.reason: the empty-iterator slot leaves an entry with id failure at a's position, and the harness's walker refuses a root status whose module ids differ from the flow's (oracle run 40994947681: "the root flow has modules [failure], but the fixture's module 0 is a"), so no observation is recorded; the refusal confirms the entry's id, not its Success status or the flow's result [], which docs/design/README.md requests through the jobs API from the next run of batch E3f (SC5)
deploying the flow whose flow_env is nested 128 levels deep crashed the CE server in oracle run 40990751153, which ended the session; no recording can be made without a server that survives it
the setting is read on the worker's own schedule, so two runs of the same fixture saw different values (unstable in oracle run 40989292429); the case is not observable as a single recording

the script whose stored schema has a type array naming array fails its lock job at deploy (oracle run 40994947681: "Error creating schema validator: ... Problem making rule for xs: Error: Array type should have field `items`"), before any run, as the case expects since the semantics revision SC5 corrected it, and the harness stops a fixture whose dependency job fails, so no fixture commits it; the run after the failed deploy needs a driver, which docs/design/README.md requests from the next run of batch E3f (SC5)
the raw_unpinned request during lock generation is visible only in the server's request log, which the harness does not capture

needs workspace object storage pointed at an S3-compatible store started beside the oracle (session A of the request), which the harness does not start; WA-16/d, the session without storage, is recorded (client-api/object-storage)
as WA-16/c: needs workspace object storage, which the harness does not start
needs a second workspace for the same user, which the harness, one workspace per fixture, does not create
as WA-4/b: needs a second workspace

re-scoped to EE by the semantics revision SC5: restarting a flow is enterprise-only at the pin, and Windmill CE has no restart; the driver of client-api/driven, run restart (oracle run 41003988171), found that the restart route the vendored OpenAPI documents, POST /jobs/restart/f/{id} with {step_id}, answers 500 (Wrong number of path arguments for `Path`. Expected 4 but got 2) on CE v1.767.0, so no CE recording can be made; it is also outside windmill-lite's equivalence contract (no restart, ADR 0001 section 1)
as JE-19/e: re-scoped to EE by the semantics revision SC5, since Windmill CE has no restart (the restart route answers 500 on CE v1.767.0; client-api/driven, run restart)

deferred with Q-OF-13's sync trees, which this batch did not build a harness session for; the semantics revision SC5 re-scoped it: it needs no push of a tree, since the flows API accepts any well-formed pin (OF-14), so a fixture deployed through the API (oracle.deploy api) in the reference session records it, and docs/design/README.md requests it from the next run of batch E3f (SC5)
